text: 你凝神倾听，灌木丛中传来一阵奇怪的窸窣声。就在营火光芒之外，有什么东西在移动。声音停在你的研究生助理伯纳德·埃布斯坦身旁，他正发出轻微的鼾声。
你拿起武器，悄无声息地走过去。厚重的云层遮住了月亮和星星。直到火光突然一闪，你才看见入侵者——几个直立行走的小小身影！你只有一瞬间决定该怎么做。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 9
text: As you listen, you hear a peculiar scurrying in the undergrowth. Just beyond the glow of the campfire, something is moving. The sound stops near the spot where your graduate assistant, Bernard Ebstein, is snoring faintly.

You pick up a weapon and pad through the silence. A heavy sky blocks the moon and stars. It is only by a sudden flaring of the fire that you see the intruders—tiny figures walking upright! You have only an instant to decide what to do.
